args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1, deployed to production (us-east, us-west, eu-west), began failing health checks with an 18% error rate across all regions. The service was rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent previously healthy release. After the rollback, checkout-api is healthy in all regions with an error rate of 0.002. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is still under investigation.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 unhealthy in all production regions; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
**Summary:**

1. **Diagnosed** the issue: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back** to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, across all regions.
3. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy in all regions with a 0.2% error rate.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** ("checkout-api v2.3.1 unhealthy in all production regions; rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure and the mitigation, which paged the on-call engineer.

The root cause of v2.3.1's failure is still under investigation.
